fields.subject: QueryStatement
fields.trigger: a caller requests Value from a Lazy<QueryStatement> returned by Create
fields.response: read the selected statement file and materialize a Text query contract using the supplied statement name and parameter-name list; the selection family shall use the current Folder and Extension defaults, caller-provided folder and extension, or a caller-provided full file path according to the chosen Create overload
fields.postcondition: the query's command text equals the file contents
